title: The AI tool that replaced 100 employees overnight

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The AI tool didn't replace 100 employees—it optimized processes, reducing errors by 90% and boosting productivity.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But at what cost? AI lacks human judgment, leading to biased decisions and eroded trust in critical systems.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Human oversight is built into the protocol—every AI action is logged, audited, and reversible via fail-safe triggers.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s just a band-aid. Real AI evolves beyond human control, creating risks we can’t predict or contain.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI isn’t just a tool—it’s a replacement, and we’re already seeing the cost in lost jobs and societal instability.
